nodes.name: Schedule Trigger
nodes.notes: Hourly. Idempotent — only picks up ai_status=pending rows; nothing pending = no-op.

nodes.name: Webhook Kick
nodes.notes: Manual / GH-Actions kick (POST /webhook/law-change-digest). Responds 200 immediately; digest runs async.

nodes.name: Global Config
nodes.notes: ⚙️ Keys + model + abstention threshold. deploy-workflow.mjs injects real keys (Starter plan has no Variables).

nodes.name: Fetch Chunks
nodes.notes: L2 input: live law_chunks (id, law_code, article_num, service_slugs). Small table — fetched whole.

nodes.name: Fetch Relations
nodes.notes: L2 input: lawyer-verified graph edges only. executeOnce (fires once despite upstream fan-out); may be empty (GraphRAG not yet live) → direct service_slugs path still works.

nodes.name: Fetch Pending
nodes.notes: L0 queue: pending rows that already carry a deterministic article_diffs. executeOnce + alwaysOutputData (single fetch, chain survives an empty queue).

nodes.name: Compute Scopes
nodes.notes: L2: per pending row → deterministic impact scope + severity ceiling + filled Groq prompt. One output item per pending row.

nodes.name: L3 Reasoning
nodes.notes: L3: Groq strict-JSON "what changed" draft. One call per pending row (item pairing preserved).

nodes.name: Critique & Decide
nodes.notes: L4: deterministic groundedness (RED → abstain) + confidence gate + severity clamp → PATCH payload.

nodes.name: Write Result

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ai_status: $json._status, ai_summary: $json._summary, ai_impact: $json._impact, ai_confidence: $json._confidence, ai_model: $json._model, ai_generated_at: $json._generated_at }) }}

nodes.notes: L5 handoff: write ai_* columns only (never notes/action). Lawyer reviews the draft in the admin panel.
